info.cls_name: 綠色能源碩一學位學程
info.cls_ename: Master Program of Green Energy Science and Technology
info.scr_teacher: 林俊德,葉丞豪,呂晃志,陳志成,張淵仁
info.scr_teacher_eng: Yuan-Jen Chang,Chen-Hao Yeh,Leu, Hoang Jyh,Chih-Cheng Chen,Yuan-Jen Chang

description.describe_ch: 此課程一半時間將聘請校內外相關領域之學者專家做專題演講，另一半時間則由碩士班同學就其所學，做與其研究主題相關之進度及心得報告，並互相討論及對問題之答覆。
description.describe_eh: Part time of the class will be the specific presentations related to green energy technology by invited specialists.  The other time of the class will be the research reports, research progresses, and discussions from the graduate students.

targets.describe_ch: 學習綠色能源科技相關之基本知識。
targets.describe_en: learn the fundamentals of green energy technology.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解綠色能源科技相關之研究內容。
targets.describe_en: understand the related research scope of green energy technology.

targets.describe_ch: 具備綠色能源科技相關研究發表之能力。
targets.describe_en: be able to present the research potential regarding to the green energy technology

targets.describe_ch: 培育溝通、表達、領導、合作、整合之能力。
targets.describe_en: to set up the capability of communication, expression, leadership, cooperation, and integration

courseBankC.describe_ch: 學習綠色能源科技相關之基本知識。
courseBankC.describe_en: learn the fundamentals of green energy technology.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備應用科學模式來描述、分析綠色能源領域相關問題，並有規劃與執行專題研究的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: 2.Students can apply scientific models to describe and analyze green energy related questions as well as develop abilities to design and execute research.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解綠色能源科技相關之研究內容。
courseBankC.describe_en: understand the related research scope of green energy technology.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備整合綠色能源相關知識進行分析、設計及獨立解決問題的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: 4.Students can integrate green energy related knowledge to analyze, design, and solve problems by themselves.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 具備綠色能源科技相關研究發表之能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: be able to present the research potential regarding to the green energy technology
courseBankC.core_item: 蒐集資料、規範問題、加以分析驗證獲得結論，並有撰寫專業論文的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: 3.Students can collect data, define questions, and carry out analysis to obtain conclusions as well as to develop abilities in thesis writing.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 培育溝通、表達、領導、合作、整合之能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: to set up the capability of communication, expression, leadership, cooperation, and integration
courseBankC.core_item: 跨領域有效溝通、清晰表達、領導管理、團隊合作分工及協調整合的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: 5.Students can effectively communicate, clearly express themselves, serve in leadership roles, and collaborate with others in different fields.
